# Third-party Agent Skills

These Skills are imported into the MacSoft protected runtime source. The
temporary clones used for import are outside this repository at
`C:\tmp\macsoft-skill-import\`. Runtime copies are generated by the existing
protected directory synchronization and are not hand-edited or committed.

All three upstream repositories were imported at the fixed commits below.
License texts are retained beside this record.

| Upstream repository | Commit | Original path | MacSoft path | License | Modification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `antvis/chart-visualization-skills` | `b43ddb6543885d55ded2815b5aab75b17643f416` | `skills/chart-visualization` | `macsoft-chart-visualization` | See `antvis-LICENSE.txt` | Rewritten for chart selection and ECharts contract; removed external API, curl, image URL, and AntV output workflow. |
| `wshobson/agents` | `c4b82b0ad771190355eb8e204b1329732a18449a` | `plugins/business-analytics/skills/kpi-dashboard-design` | `kpi-dashboard-design` | See `wshobson-agents-LICENSE.txt` | Retained references; shortened metadata and added MacSoft data-integrity and HTML boundaries. |
| `wshobson/agents` | `c4b82b0ad771190355eb8e204b1329732a18449a` | `plugins/business-analytics/skills/data-storytelling` | `data-storytelling` | See `wshobson-agents-LICENSE.txt` | Retained references; shortened metadata and added evidence and HTML boundaries. |
| `ConardLi/garden-skills` | `aaf9a82f5efd73e87cc0998edc398e75bfc35901` | `skills/web-design-engineer` | `web-design-engineer` | See `garden-skills-LICENSE.txt` | Retained references and agent metadata; adapted dashboard guidance to MacSoft HTML and ECharts constraints. |

The source README and repository-level manifests are not runtime Skill
content, so they were not copied into the protected Skill directories. The
selected Skill references and the web-design agent metadata were retained.

`macsoft-chart-dashboard` is original MacSoft work and is not represented as
third-party source. It coordinates the imported Skills and the existing
`macsoft-autocount:autocount-operations` Skill.
